_what: THE INCUMBENT FORMAT'S GATE NUMBERS. These are the pinned D15 numbers, written down here rather than left as defaults inside scripts/cpcv.mjs so that a per-format gate reads every format the same way -- `data/formats/<key>/golden.json` for a built format, this file for the incumbent (whose model files live at the data/ root).
_playoffPct: PRIMARY GATE (D13): the axis the season sim has measured skill on (playoff Brier 0.2370 vs uniform 0.2451). Source: data/experiments.jsonl config_hash e625249e, full_set_baseline_playoff_pct 96.107, at benchDiscount 0.25 / consensusBlend 0 -- both title-edges demoted (D14/D15), so this pre-edge base IS the shipped posture.
_titlePct: SECONDARY / CONTEXT ONLY, never gated: the sim has NO measured skill on the single-elim title (title Brier 0.0659 vs uniform 0.0652, P16 FAILED). Same ledger row, full_set_baseline_pct 38.48. The old title-tuned posture (--consensus-blend 1 --bench-discount 0.35) was 97.0 / 42.3.
_tolerancePp: +/- pp of Monte-Carlo slack on the consistency check, unchanged from cpcv.mjs's --golden-tol default.
